The '''Thirty-first Recon''' was a military unit in the [[Mantellian Army]] active during the [[Separatist War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], part of the broader [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==History==
{{Quote|My mission is to deliver recon on this village, but I can't report anything through this interference! I need those separatist jammers neutralized--so if you're headed into the village anyway, maybe you can handle it for us.|Sergeant Blyes requests aid from Republic heroes|<ref name="CtA">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Clearing the Air|[[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]}}</ref>}}
During the [[Separatist War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="3643BBY">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of the Thirty-first Recon was engaged in [[Battle in Drelliad village|fighting]] outside [[Drelliad village]] on the island of [[Avilatan]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Squad member [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Jendan Blyes]] recruited two Republic heroes to disable three separatist signal [[Jammer/Legends|jammers]] in the village so the unit could transmit their reconnaissance reports to their superiors at [[Fort Garnik]], a nearby Republic military base.<ref name="CtA" /> Shortly thereafter, the unit's [[Private/Legends|Private]] [[Wesner]] secured the heroes assistance to eliminate separatist [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]] operating in the vicinity of Fort Garnik. On their way to the fort, the heroes defeated several snipers<ref name="SH" /> and other separatist forces.<ref name="BtE">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Blinding the Enemy|[[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Thirty-first Recon first appeared on Ord Mantell in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SH" />
